newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-BOGUSZ OWN GOAL FLOORS WIDZEW LODZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOGUSZ OWN GOAL FLOORS WIDZEW LODZ.

text.p: Steaua Bucharest kept alive their remote chances of advancing to the European Cup quarter-finals on Wednesday by beating Polish champions Widzew Lodz -- courtesy of an own goal.
They won 1-0 to record their first win at the third attempt in group B of the champions' league.
Hapless defender Daniel Bogusz poked the ball into his own net during a goalmouth scramble just eight minutes from time.
His goal climaxed a rousing second half during which Steaua's Laurentiu Rosu and Lodz's Miroslav Szymkowiak hit the bar.
Steaua dominated long periods of the match but without the prompting of banned midfielder Adrian Ilie they lacked a cutting edge.
Delighted Steaua coach Dumitru Dumitriu said: "I'm so happy because my team banished the memories of two heavy defeats."
Steaua were crushed 4-0 away by Atletico Madrid and 3-0 at home by Borussia Dortmund.
Widzew's third successive group defeat almost certainly killed off their chances of making the last eight.
